name: inspect_managed_members
description: Inspect PE/CLI metadata members, signatures, raw CIL hashes, decoded-instruction-tuple hashes, separately reported exception regions, call edges, and field-access anchors without loading or executing target code. Metadata tokens are reported as build-local coordinates bound to the artifact SHA-256 and MVID; the tuple hash does not resolve them or fully commit control flow.
